title: Michigan's 12th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for Michigan's 12th Congressional District will determine who represents this safely Democratic seat covering parts of Wayne and Oakland counties, including Dearborn, parts of Detroit, Southfield, Inkster, and Livonia. Incumbent Democrat Rashida Tlaib, first elected in 2018, is seeking a fifth term and faces a competitive Democratic primary challenge from Inkster Mayor Byron Nolen and former state representative Shanelle Jackson. The district has the largest concentration of Arab American voters in the United States and has a Cook Partisan Voting Index of D+21, making the Democratic nominee heavily favored in the general election. The Republican primary features James Hooper, a conservative activist and perennial candidate who previously ran for this seat in 2022.
polling_note: No publicly available opinion polls were found for the 2026 Michigan 12th Congressional District race as of mid-2026. The primary is scheduled for August 4, 2026.

candidates.name: Rashida Tlaib
candidates.summary: Rashida Tlaib is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Michigan's 12th Congressional District, first elected in 2018. She made history as the first Muslim woman in the Michigan Legislature and one of the first two Muslim women in Congress, as well as the first Palestinian-American woman in Congress. Tlaib is a progressive Democrat and member of the Democratic Socialists of America who serves on the House Financial Services and Oversight committees, and is known for her criticism of U.S. foreign policy in Israel and Gaza.

candidates.name: Shanelle Jackson
candidates.summary: Shanelle Jackson is a former Michigan State Representative who served the 9th district from 2007 to 2012. A Democrat from Detroit, she previously ran for this congressional seat in 2022, finishing fourth in the Democratic primary with approximately 5% of the vote. Jackson has also run for Congress in 2012 and 2018, and has worked in the private sector since leaving the legislature.

candidates.name: Byron H. Nolen
candidates.summary: Byron Nolen is the Mayor of Inkster, Michigan, and a seasoned litigation attorney with 27 years of legal experience. He is challenging incumbent Rashida Tlaib in the Democratic primary, positioning himself as a more mainstream Democrat critical of Tlaib's refusal to endorse Kamala Harris in the 2024 presidential election. Nolen previously served as Inkster mayor from 2015 to 2019 and was re-elected in 2023, and his campaign focuses on civil rights, constitutional freedoms, and economic development.

candidates.name: James D. Hooper
candidates.summary: James Hooper is a Republican candidate for Michigan's 12th Congressional District who describes himself as a 'liberty-minded conservative' and 'blue-collar Republican.' He serves as Wayne County Republican Chairman and previously ran for this seat in the 2022 Republican primary, finishing second. Hooper's background includes work in the building trades, mission work overseas with Samaritan's Purse in Liberia, and serving as a caregiver for his mother. His platform emphasizes pro-life values, American energy independence, tax reduction, and eliminating the U.S. Department of Education.
